reviews.text: They're always wonderful with my cats, especially my very scared tabby. Dr. Palis and the techs are amazing. I highly recommend them!

Always friendly and accommodating.
And SO much love for “Whiskey”..

Saying goodbye to a beloved pet is one of the hardest things a person can go through, but the staff at Love City Vet handled the entire process with extraordinary grace, empathy, and respect. From the moment we walked in, they made sure my beloved dog, Lucy, was comfortable, gentle, and peaceful. The vet and care team took their time, explained everything clearly, and never made us feel rushed. I am so deeply grateful for their compassion and kindness during such a painful moment. I couldn't have asked for a more caring team to help us say our final goodbye.
Great staff. Very friendly and knowledgeable

First time at Love City Vet, was recommended by a friend and is closer to home. Glad we switched! Dr. Amber Lee and team were so kind and gentle with my senior dog. They addressed all of my concerns and gave me options moving forward with a mass that needs to be removed. Thanks Love City team!
Denise, we truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. 🐾 …
As always the most loving care for my pup Gryffin. They are simply the best!
Margaret, we truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. 🐾 …

Fantastic vet for my two cats. All of the staff are very friendly and clearly love animals. They are very patient and will explain any aspects of your pet's care. Whenever we have questions, they always answer them fully. The practice also has often been able to accommodate us when we needed immediate appointments.

Love City Doctors and staff have been very warm, comforting, informative and knowledgeable! Our beautiful, loving cat Dixon, has been dealing with illness and it has been painful to watch him going through so many changes. Love City Docs and staff have been extremely helpful, comforting and reassuring with their expertise. We all of the staff and Dixon does too. We highly recommend them to take care of your pets. We truly trust them! They love what they do and it shows! We thank them and appreciate their wonderful professionals!

I would give Love City Vet 100 stars if I could.  I was referred to Love City by a friend of mine & I'm so glad I took my fur baby there.  At our first appointment we were greeted by the friendliest receptionist & made to feel very welcomed. The vet tech & veterinarian we saw were amazing. My dog was a little nervous but they lovingly calmed her while doing a very thorough exam. They explained why she may have skin issues & gave me a plan of action to follow along with topicals & supplements that worked great.  We just had our follow up visit & her skin is much improved. I was asked which test 'd be ok with them doing & I was told the cost of each test & medication beforehand so there was no surprises at checkout.  The cost of a visit & exam is very reasonable & in my opinion the best around. I highly recommend Love City Vet!

I LOVE Love City Vet. They have been nothing but professional, compassionate, and extremely knowledgeable. The vets are amazing. This practice is very up front about potential costs of care and does not push services. I have seen both Dr. Wheeler and Dr. Palis and they are both obviously well-educated and remain up-to-date on pet care. The vet techs are also amazing! The front desk woman is professional and kind as well. It rook me several vet practices to stumble upon Love City Vet and I am so glad I did.
Very friendly staff that genuinely cares about making sure your pet is happy and healthy .
We had our first Vet visit at love city and we were very appreciative of how they handled our anxious dog. Dr. Catherine Cryer and her tech were great!

When love isn’t enough, Love City is there for you.

My pup was incredibly anxious. Our previous vet constantly made me feel as if my dog was a burden. So many things went undiagnosed, or missed, and everything came back to “what are you doing to make your dog this nervous.”

Going to Love City was like a big hug. On his first arrival they heard his distinct heart murmur that had gone ignored and alerted me to the early signs of heart failure. Less than a month later, when I heard the cough, they described I knew exactly what we had to do. Having a dog with heart disease isn’t easy, and having an anxious one that needs regular visits isn’t any easier. But Love City always made us feel welcomed. From their front desk staff to their vet techs, to the wonderful Dr. Wheeler every step of the way I felt my dog was cherished. Instead of the stark judgements of how we were failing to have such a nervous dog they answered every question, every call, opened schedules for emergencies and through it all lead with love, kindness, and an expertise one can only wish for in a vet team. During some of the darkest days, when I was so use to trying to guess what was wrong with him because of our previous vet, Dr. Wheeler let me know it wasn’t up to me to figure it out, but that they would work as hard as they could to hep him, and they did. The team at Love City advocated and called in experts when his case grew more complicated. The kind of investment they made in the quality of life my dog had is something I can never truly thank them for. The normal lifespan of a dog once they hit heart failure is 1 year. Our brave dog lived for 2 ½ years. A huge part of the journey was Love City. Their care was so good after we moved to Conshohocken, I would still drive to South Philly to see his team. If battling 76 isn’t a testament to how good, they are I don’t know what is.
They are so kind and caring. My dog has bad anxiety and they help her to feel safe. Also, I have never waited more than 5 minutes before being waited on. Very clean. Love it here!

I took my sick kitty, Sadie, to LCV on Friday. My cat has been going to SHVH  for years but I'm in a new neighborhood and I knew, if I were to go to any other vet in the city, I'd take her to LCV. My girl has been under the weather for a few days. She usually bounces back but she didn't and I knew she needed blood work and, unfortunately according to the vet, that rads were recommended. Dr. Cryer, upon palpitations on her belly, she felt enlarged organs and believes it to be cancer. I guess we'll find out tomorrow. My girl is a rescue. I do not know how old she was when I took her off the street.. maybe are was 1ish? I've had her about 14 years. We've been through so much together. For now, under Dr. Cryer's recommendations, she is on steroids. She got fluids and cerenia. She perked up a bit. Dr. Cryer was compassionate, thorough, and kind. I appreciate knowing... Though I'm hoping for a different outcome. Prices were reasonable, as well. The office is beautiful and modern. I don't remember the technicians name but she's was bubbly and am absolute doll. Thank you all.

We just adopted a puppy and took him to Love City Vet for his first visit. The best experience we've ever had with a vet! Every staff member from receptionist to tech to doctor was friendly and knowledgeable. And the facility was sparkling clean and new. Our pup had so much fun snuggling with the loving staff, and they did such a good job of distracting him that he didn't even notice getting his vaccines. So happy to have found LCV!

I had a super pleasant experience bringing my cat to this vet. Our cat is our first pet and I had no prior experience with them so it was all new. They were very thorough and so delighted by my cat. And answered all our questions. Super lovely experience!
Always professional and helpful. All the staff is polite. I take my cats at Love City Vet whenever they need to go and the service is great.

I love taking my pets to Love City Vet.  They are wonderful and I had a wonderful experience taking my 14 year Fred yesterday.  They treat me and my pet with compassion and they go over all the prices before they get started.  I give them five Stars and will continue bringing my fur babies to them.
The staff is friendly and caring. My dog felt safe and loved meeting everyone. All health concerns i brought up were handled effectively and efficiently. The care is wonderful.
Had a wonderful experience here and they took care of my old girl! 💕
Lovecity Vet is a great. Professional and thorough and compassionate 🩵 …
I came to the Oregon Ave location and was very satisfied. The staff were really friendly and kind, gave detailed options and explanations of costs, and the overall experience was incredibly positive.
My Cat Vamp got well treated  thank you 🙏🫶 …
This place is great! Staff is kind and quick while providing detailed information.

Love city vet is the diamond in the rough! Since the day I walked in I have never felt like anything but loved and well taken care of!! Sometimes I don’t even want to leave. My Pippa Middleton has been thru so much and when the time came that she needed a more involved surgery Dr. Lenahen called and spoke with the facility to be sure my Pippas’ unusual anxieties was dealt with in the best fashion. Yesterday, knowing that Pippa has seizures just walking through the door, Lattana, Chrissy and Dr. Palis didn’t have her walk through the door instead, they came to my car and treated my baby in my car.  They examined her, took her blood and loved her every second.  I moved last year away from Philly but will never stop coming to Love City Vet. Chefs kiss to my favorite veterinarian hospital and staff! From the bottom of my heart…THANK YOU AND I APPRECIATE ALL OF YOU!

The best vet and team ever! From Lattana the smiling face of the practice, Angela a phenomenal Vet Tech and Dr Lenahen the first Vet able to diagnose my cats back leg problem! Dr Lenahen is smart, listens and diagnoses. They all really really love the animals and contribute to the great vibe that you get as soon as you walk in!

Staff is amazing, free parking, great care at a great price! BEST practice ever!

No price gouging here!
Very attentive to my questions and resolved quickly.

My dog and I have moved around a lot in the past 9 years, and this is my favorite vet he's ever had. Both times I've been there, everyone has been so lovely and friendly - from the receptionist to the tech to the doctor. You can tell they really love the animals they care for. I've felt listened to and like Dr. Wheeler takes concerns seriously. She is very thorough and diligent, and I'm glad she'll be our vet for the years we're in Philly.
Great, caring staff and a nice office space.
Took my cat in for an annual check up and vaccines. They were great with him, also very friendly and had helpful answers to all my questions.

I am so glad a friend told me that a new veterinary, was in Whitman plaza. I took my pet and was very happy I went there. It is a very nice place. The Dr and staff were great.
They told me what was wrong with Roxy and what the plan is to get her better.
It is the best vet I ever went to. I was able to go in with her. I am recommending every one to go there. ❤
Friendly staff, nice doctor. Facility was clean and they took good care of my cat.

I found them when I had my cat down of 22 years ago and it was such a diffrent experience they make everyone comfortable and much more personable. Then my parents can’t went and received excellent care and now saddly I’m back with my other cat , but there are good  even my cat was clam thru his appointment and they have been so helpful . This will remain my forever vet !! And they are reasonable they not gonna rob ya for the care of your beloved pet . Highly recommend

I was searching for an independently-owned vet after my old vet started raising prices and being very pushy. I'm so happy that I found LoveCity Vet! They are so warm and welcoming. My dog is 14 years old, and they treat him with care. No pushing for extra tests, just taking care of my dog's needs. The best part is that before they end the appointment, they show you a list of all the medication and/or procedures they recommend. The tech goes over each one and the price to get your approval before anything is started. That means no surprise bills or miscommunication about what is happening. I'm so happy that I found LoveCity Vet!
Katya, we truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. 🐾 🫶 …

Have taken my cat there twice now, and both times she has received lovely care. They are very transparent about the entire visit, and they focus on getting answers to your concerns.

I am so happy to have finally gone to a place where my asthmatic cat can get the help and answers she needs so that we can move forward with a plan rather than aimlessly.

Took my kitten here for her vaccine follow up and I’ve never been so pleased with a vet. From the front desk, the tech and the Dr, everyone is absolutely lovely. I’ll recommend Love City Vet over and over and over again.
Great vet. Dr. Palis has been wonderful following my cat who has several issues. Recommend

Everyone at Love City Vet treats our babies with so much care. We were amazed by how easily they handled our anxious, reactive cat, with love and without judgement. Talented professionals and kind human beings! We’ll keep coming back!
Love this place. They are very through, knowledgeable and very friendly.

This is the vet you've been looking for! Every member of the staff is so kind, friendly, and straightforward about care for pets. We were referred by friends and had taken our animals for wellness visits in the beginning of 2026 and loved them. Then, we noticed one of our precious cats behaving strangely in June. What we thought would be a simple problem ended up with us having to decide to put her down. The vet was honest about the probable cost for diagnostic testing and did not pressure us at all as we decided on the best course. The Love City Vet team immediately offered referrals for in-home euthanasia before even suggesting doing it in their office. Due to time constraints we ended up going into the office and it was the best possible version of a terrible thing. We were in a room with a couch and they gave us a doorbell so that we could signal when we were ready for each step, assuring us we could have as much time as we needed.
Along with their warm presence, they are also the most transparent vet about pricing that I've ever experienced. Their prices are very reasonable, especially for the area, and have always offered clear quotes with multiple options and no shame when you need time to save up or can't afford a specific option.
As long as I'm in Philly, I won't be going to another vet.

My dog is really scared of the vet (mostly from really bad experiences at Queen Village Animal
Hospital) but the vet made her experience quick and painless and were also just lovely to chat with. So happy I found Love City!
This place is amazing! The vet and staff are very patient and understanding with patients and parents. Communication is very good, explaining everything clearly. Thank you for your care.

I was very happy with my first visit to love city vet. My dog is by no means easy to work with and is very reactive to shots and examinations, but Dr. Wheeler and Chrissy did an amazing job of handling him despite this. They were able to make sure he got everything needed for his annual appointment and were very kind and understanding about his reactions. The team addressed all of my concerns and did not make me feel rushed. They also gave me suggestions and a written out plan to try and improve my dog’s vet anxieties for his next visit. To top it all off, the team was very transparent about pricing throughout the whole appointment and I felt that their prices were very reasonable (honestly I was kind of surprised that it didn’t break the bank).

Long story short, this is a wonderful vet practice that has kind, knowledgeable staff and all for a reasonable price. I’m glad to have found Winston’s new vet 😊
Wonderful and kind staff,so helpful when we needed them!

I highly recommend Love City Vet.
Dr Wheeler and the technicians were so kind and compassionate. They took the time to answer any questions and concerns I had, and I love that I could reach out to the staff via text messaging regarding any concerns I had while caring for my pet at home. Truly such wonderful experience, we could feel the love.
Love City is always extremely thorough and thoughtful of any concerns
Love you guys! Always a pleasure to bring my dog here! Would recommend to anybody who wants their dog to be loved and cared for by the best :)

Love City Vet is wonderful, they are so knowledgeable, kind and my little cat has never been so calm during her exam. Her exams are thorough and everything is explained clearly - I have learned so much from them. Thanks you Dr. Palis and the wonderful nurses and front desk staff for keeping my little chili pepper happy and healthy.

I have been bringing my 5-year-old dog to Love City for the past year and it has been the best decision. Every staff member at this office is so kind, sweet, and professional! Appointments are super easy to book through the portal. So convenient that there’s a parking lot too!!

Friendly staff, clean, did not feel rushed, they made sure to explain everything and made sure I had no questions, including going over prices before treatments. I have 2 dogs, Dr Wheeler and the RNs (sorry I forgot their names), got down on the floor with Lilly, patiently helping her to not be afraid. When I took Jackson, they were not intimidated by his large Bull Mastiff size, they treated him with the same level of affection. Appointments started on time. They are very mindful about booking, you won't be in a room full of cats and dogs all waiting to be seen. That's a huge + for me.
Staffs was very helpful and kind. Thank you

I really like the atmosphere. The staff and the veterinarians are very sweet and will always work with you. I really feel like they're my partners in caring for my furry ones. I highly recommend them!!

Love Love City Vet! Dr Abby is incredibly caring and knowledgeable. I appreciate the time and effort she is putting in with both of my challenging dogs.
The entire group of Vets and technicians are 1st class and all provide excellent care.
The concierge are welcoming, friendly and helpful setting the tone from the get go.
It’s a true team effort designed for caring for your pets and their families.

Hi Dawvid. Thank you so much for the 5 stars and for trusting us with your pet's care — that truly means the world to our team!

We did want to gently address your note about pricing. Transparency is something we hold dear at Love City Vet — we always provide an estimate before any services are performed so there are never any surprises, and we publish our pricing openly at lovecityvet.com/philadelphia-pa-pricing/ so pet owners can plan ahead.

We also know that veterinary care is a real financial investment, which is why we've worked hard to offer a variety of ways to make it more manageable. We accept most forms of payment and offer a variety of other options  — plus we work with most pet insurance providers. You can learn more at lovecityvet.com/payment-options/. If cost is ever a concern before a visit, please don't hesitate to reach out — we're always happy to talk through a plan that works for you and your pet!

Love City Vet really helped with my cat Claire Noelle
I was put at ease and they are really caring
The doctor and the staff are wonderful.. the best vet I ever went to.

I can't say enough wonderful things about Love City Vet. From our very first visit, Dr. Wheeler made us feel like we had been patients for years. She is incredibly compassionate, thoughtful, and genuinely cares about both her patients and the people who love them. During one of the hardest times of my life, she helped me navigate every decision with kindness and understanding. The nurses and staff were just as amazing, every interaction was met with warmth, patience, and compassion. I will always be grateful for the care Stanley received, and I have complete confidence bringing my other pets here. If you're looking for a veterinary team that truly treats your pets like family, I wholeheartedly recommend this practice.
Dr. Abby and the attending vet techs were great! Dr. Abby answered all my questions and was so good at handling my cat and putting him at ease. I loved my visit and will be going back

I went to Love City Vet South Philly yesterday for the first time for an Emergency for my 8 month old kitten .
Dr.Rachel Palis,was amazing intelligent caring and very knowledgeable. Vet Tech Caroline,and the Dr were both very gentle and took there time with my kitten who is afraid of everyone .They made my cat BeBop and my husband and I feel very comfortable. I will be seeing them again due to my cat's problem .I feel like we are in great hands. This is speaking from experience because I was a vet tech for years until I retired! I would recommend anyone who is looking for a vet to go here.

Absolutely the best experience with a vet we’ve ever had! The office is very clean and every single staff member was warm and inviting. One of our dogs is extremely anxious so going to the vet has always been challenging but everyone there made the situation so much less stressful than we’ve ever experienced anywhere else. Our sweet, but nervous girl did great and we’re not worried about taking her for checkups anymore. A huge win! We highly recommend Dr. Palis for her kindness, patience, and professionalism. The prices are very reasonable and they care more about the best course of care rather than price gouging. We truly can’t recommend them enough. Thank you Dr. Palis and everyone at Love City Vets! ❤️
Everyone in this office from the front desk on, is delightful! I love that is woman owned and they keep you apprised of the cost throughout your appointment.  Highly recommend!!
Always accomodatimg and caring.   I fully trust Love City Vet with my baby girl MiaMarie❤️
Melanie, thanks for the 5 stars! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …
Shireen, thank you so much for the 5-star review. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

Love City Vet is so great with my doggie Olivia! Olivia is a rescue from a tough background and they are so patient with her. I have recommended Love City Vet to friends and they have great experiences as well.
Everyone was so helpful. It is very clean and modern. As stressful as it is when your pet is sick it's nice to be well cared for.

The team at Love City never fail to impress us! They’re super knowledgeable, highly personable and respond quickly with any questions or concerns we have. They helped us best manage our cat, Mothball, when she developed an unexpected spinal issue, and after exploring different treatment options were incredibly supportive when it became clear that putting her down was the humane choice. Having to say goodbye to a beloved pet  so early was difficult but the Love City team were there for us the entire way. Based on that experience and their continued excellence,I wouldn’t trust anyone else to care for our dog, Pony.

I highly recommend Love City Vet. My cat suddenly developed severe allergies, and they've been incredible every step of the way.

Their level of expertise, patience, and empathy is exceptional. The communication throughout the entire process has been wildly comforting. Dr. Palis and Steph took my very real anxiety and stress and met it with kindness, walking me through every appointment, clearly explaining the diagnosis, discussing next steps, and making sure I always know how we're moving forward.

One thing I've especially appreciated is that they send a detailed summary after each visit, recapping everything we discussed. It's been invaluable to have something to reference when there's so much information to process.

The whole experience feels clean, organized, and thoughtful—with a whole lot of love tossed in. I couldn't recommend them more.

I had a regular veterinarian for over 26 years. I felt like my cat wasn’t diagnosed properly. I called as an emergency to love city . They were accommodating and had me come right in with my Joey. Unfortunately he needed to be put down. When I say they treated me like family, it’s an understatement! The love and support we received during this difficult time is beyond words!!! Thank you for everything!!! I will bring my 2 other furbabies here!!

I had an excellent experience at LoveCity Vet for the second time. The staff was friendly and attentive, and the facility was clean and well-maintained. I highly recommend this vet clinic to anyone new to the city. The staff was incredibly caring and took great care of my cat when she visited.

My first time at a vet with my new cats and they came highly recommended and I saw why! I got taken to a room immediately upon arrival so my cats didn’t have to cry in the waiting room. They were so gentle and quick with my cats, they immediately calmed down once we went back to the room. They explained everything so thoroughly to me and were so nice. Reasonably priced services, the exam is $78 and I paid that in my deposit as a New Patient and then after that were vaccines as needed.
Staff were great, and very gentle with a kitten I brought in for a checked up. Sleeve says thank you.
Great staff, fabulous facility, resonable prices and convenient location! Will be back with my other two kitties!

Love City is an excellent pet hospital. They have been so helpful to all of my crazy critters.  I really like all of the doctors, techs & staff there which is pretty unusual.  It’s very clean & inviting.  I really trust them with my fur babies.  It’s not cheap but it’s better than some other vets I’ve been to in the city.  I wouldn’t go anywhere else right now.
Love City staff really seem to care about our pets and work with us to be able to find the best treatments and options for us.

I take both of my cats to Love City Vet in South Philly & I love them. The staff - from the front desk to the doctors - are kind and friendly. They get you into the exam room quickly, minimizing pet interactions in the waiting area. I have a torty who is very anxious with new people. I took my other cat in first and while there for an appointment, I expressed my worries about bringing my torty in for her well visit. The staff were understanding, helpful, and supportive. I brought her in and she had a great well visit. This was a big deal to me, as our prior vet was not as understanding or helpful and made me feel like my cat was a burden. The appointments are straightforward - they let you know about cost up front so there are no surprises. When I needed a sick visit for my cat, I was able to schedule one within 24 hours of calling. It’s been a great experience for myself and my two cats.
I highly recommend Love City!
Everyone is so friendly and willing to answer any questions we have

We have had such a wonderful experience working with Love City Vet. Our kitty has had several health issues arise this year and Dr. Wheeler, Dr. Abby, and the staff have been so helpful and supportive while we navigate the process of getting our cat well again. Their thorough care has meant a lot and we are so glad we found them!

Great Veterinarian clinic.  They are incredibly friendly, helpful and take the time to explain everything. They are 100% focused on helping your pet. They give you an estimate so you can decide what you want to do with absolutely no pressure. Their prices are very fair as well.
They were great with my dog.  Took their time and explained everything to me.
Fabulous very clean and beautiful staff and friendly definitely will be back
I love this vet, it has wonderful staff, great care for my baby Hazel , and a clean, welcoming office. Couldn’t ask for a better experience for my pet❤️ and there not to pricey.

Reasonable pricing compared to other places called and very thorough and empathetic when I initially called. The dr and tech explained everything with me and let me know pricing for everything wonderful experience thank you ❤️

I love Love City Vet!!! My dog absolutely hates the vet and unfortunately needs to be sedated but they truly make the experience as easy as possible. They really care about the pets and try to make the experience as nice as possible for them! Truly recommend!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Melissa. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

The staff is amazing! Kobe came to me with zero history. He had double ear infections and severe anxiety. He was in pain and scared. They lived on him and did what needed to be done not what they could have done. I don’t feel like they pushed treatment like I have in other offices. I am happy to say he is settling in and his ears are much better.
